thread:
incident-bot: P0 alert — us-central1 GPU capacity exhausted and autoscaler failing to provision new nodes. Queue depth for inference workers on model: text-gen-large is spiking > 30k. Paging @sre_oncall and @alice-runtime :rotating_light:

sre_oncall: I'm on it, jumping into the dashboard now. Any reports of errors from the autoscaler?

alice-runtime: Seeing repeated 403/QUOTA_EXCEEDED from GCE API when creating instances. Error snippet: `quotaExceeded: Insufficient regional GPU quota for project`

bob-cloudops: Confirmed. GCP console shows us-central1 GPU quota at cap. Recent autoscale burst tried to create 12 n1-highmem with T4s and failed.

jessica-prod: Customer impact: a few large customers are seeing request timeouts and rate-limited retries. Support queue has multiple P1 tickets (Derek, can you confirm count?)

derek-support: 7 active P1s tied to backend latency > 30s and 504s. Escalating to SEs for manual customer comms.

sre_oncall: Immediate mitigation ideas: 1) Reduce concurrency downstream to throttle incoming traffic, 2) Shift new traffic to fallback region (us-east1), 3) Temporarily reroute lowest-priority tenants to smaller quantized model. Which are viable now?

alice-runtime: We can push a routing rule to send non-SLA routes to us-east1 within 2-3m if we flip the policy. However need to ensure model variant exists and is warmed there. Warmup status: us-east1 has 4 warm T4 workers for text-gen-large.

bob-cloudops: I can submit emergency quota increase to GCP console but that takes hours and needs approvals. Also opening a TG with GCP support (case 123456789).

jessica-prod: Prioritize customer-facing mitigation first: Derek, send templated note to affected customers explaining transient capacity issue and temporary routing while we fix. Use channel #customer-impact to track responses.

derek-support: Sending initial note now. Template: "We're routing your traffic to an alternate region to restore service; performance should be comparable though there may be slight latency increase. We'll follow up when normal capacity resumes"

alice-runtime: Actioning routing flip. Pushing config change: `route_policies.set('region_override','us-east1', filter=tenant in low_priority_tenants)` — rolling out canary 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Starting canary now.

incident-bot: Deploy started by alice-runtime at 1796123501. Canary 10% applied.

sre_oncall: Monitoring queue after canary... queue depth dropped 18% in 90s. Good sign. Keep canary for 3m, then promote. Also lowering per-request max concurrency from 16 -> 8 for best-effort tenants to free up slots.

bob-cloudops: Added interim autoscaler tweak: reduce scale_up_cooldown from 300s -> 60s and temporarily increase target_cpu to 70 to avoid premature scale-down. This helps if quota freed.

alice-runtime: Canary -> 50% at 1796123575. Warmup: us-east1 warmed to 12 workers.

incident-bot: Canary promoted to 50% by alice-runtime.

marco-customer: Noting we saw degraded latency for internal batch jobs ~10 minutes prior. Glad to see routing help. Please keep us updated if any queued jobs will be dropped.

jessica-prod: No drops planned; we will process queued requests in fallback region. If we cannot, we will send customer-level ETA and offer retry windows.

sre_oncall: Quick checklist for handoff to next oncall in 20m: 1) Confirm us-central1 quota request progress with GCP case, 2) Keep routing rule until quota increased and us-central1 warmed, 3) Revert autoscaler cooldown after quota resolved, 4) Postmortem owners: alice-runtime + bob-cloudops.

bob-cloudops: GCP case updated: provisional uplift requested, ETA unknown. Also filed support chat to request expedited quota.

incident-bot: On-call handoff reminder scheduled in 20m.

sre_oncall: I'll leave summary in #incidents for the follow-up shiftover. Current status: routing at 50% -> promoting to 100% in 3m if queue continues to drop. No customers dropped. Open action items: alice-runtime to promote routing + warmups, bob-cloudops to chase GCP quota, jessica-prod to coordinate customer comms, derek-support to update tickets.

alice-runtime: Promoting to 100% now. `route_policies.promote('region_override')` — done at 1796123618. Confirming us-central1 queue stabilized and decreased ~72% from peak.

incident-bot: Routing promotion completed at 1796123618.

sre_oncall: Great. Leaving the incident in progress for visibility until quota resolved. Will hand off to next oncall in 20m. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
